documents.title: Elapso proxime anno
documents.rights_basis: United States public domain: the historical English translation was printed in Robert J. M‘Ghee, The Nullity of the Government of Queen Victoria in Ireland (Dublin: Richard Moore Tims; London: Simpkin, Marshall and Co., 1839), pp. 209–214. The native title/imprint on PDF page 7 and all translation-bearing native pages 263–268 were visually inspected on 2026-10-30. The 1839 printing supplies this translation's publication evidence independently of the act's 1751 date. The maximum historical term has expired under the repository's United States rights position in src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml (17 U.S.C. 304–305; 104A remainder where applicable). This derivative excludes modern digitization furniture and separately identified surrounding polemical commentary. Historical source wording is excluded from Triptych's CC BY 4.0.
documents.rights_notice: Historical English translation published in 1839; public domain in the United States on its identified printing basis. Status elsewhere may differ. Source wording is excluded from Triptych's project-content license.
documents.source_note: Robert J. M‘Ghee's unofficial historical English translation, 1839, pp. 209–214 (facsimile PDF pages 263–268). Title/imprint and every translation-bearing native page were inspected. The surrounding polemical caption and pp. 210–211 excursus are excluded. Three historical editor interpolations are separated from Benedict XIV's body and retained here, in source order: section 3: (Let me now entreat particular attention to the Bull which is here renewed); section 4: (that is excepted from the privileges of the sanctuary,); (of the sanctuary). Native spelling and translation infelicities are preserved, including printed 'commuicated'. Line-end word divisions and transparent OCR spacing are resolved by the retained exact-hash replay recipe; no new translation is supplied.
documents.witness: M‘Ghee, The Nullity of the Government of Queen Victoria in Ireland (1839), pp.209–214
